title: Alibaba Qwen History: From Tongyi Qianwen to Qwen 3.8 (2026)
summary: Qwen history from 2023 to 2026: how Alibaba built Tongyi Qianwen into the most fine-tuned open model family, from Qwen 2.5 and Qwen 3 to Qwen 3.7 Max and 3.8.
body_markdown:
The TSK-1 Benchmark sends the same app request to each model family inside Taskade Genesis and checks whether the app works, saves data, and accepts follow-up edits. The Qwen results page summarizes the family as best for value on long, detailed forms, and it keeps a dated record of every test, including the edits that did not finish.
